balls.text: Slower one beats the heave, stumps are rattled! It was a slot ball but the cutter snuck in. Jadeja cleared his front leg out the way and went for an almighty heave across the line. Tried to go square, missed it completely.
Back to full pace. Full on middle and leg, Moeen stayed leg side and whipped it along the ground to deep midwicket
Free hit is too full, the 117kph ball is driven hard. Goes to long-on

Is that a no-ball on height? Yes. The high full-toss was outside off, Moeen tried to swipe it away, missed it. Moeen was just taking off a few feet in front of the crease and Jadeja was almost next to him. Made it
Slower ball is on a length, at this stage it's slot for Moeen. Picks up the 129kph ball from knee-roll height, whips it over midwicket for an 85-metre six
Fullish ball outside off, driven into the pitch. Goes to cover
Shami starts with a full toss from around the wicket, it's mowed wide of midwicket. Man in the deep runs to the right and dives, can't stop it
Throw is at the wrong end - bowler's end and Moeen survives. It was full and wide, slapped through wide mid-off. Fielder got there, Jadeja was quick and it came to the bowler's end

Slower one is ballooned to cover and the volume goes from 100 to 0 as Hardik nonchalantly takes it around head-height and throws it towards the bowler. It was wide around a length and MS reached out and tried to slap it aerially
Into the pitch, outside off. Dragged across with the pull. To deep midwicket along the ground

Makes room and thrashes the slower full ball over cover. It was just outside off and Jadeja had manufactured room, easy swipe to take the 101kph ball into the outfield. Ump has a word with Jadeja, who was in the danger zone on the middle of the pitch, as he chatted with Dhoni
Wide and full on 135kph, Dhoni crouches and reaches out. Guides to deep-backward point. CSK's 150 is up
Short outside off, Sponges up off the pitch, pulled to deep midwicket
Mistimes the slog sweep, the full ball goes off the top edge. Shanaka runs in from the deep to take the catch. Googly there from Rashid
Rayudu picks the length early, it's length only but bounces a bit extra. Flies off the bat over midwicket for a big six
pens the face to dab the length ball at 87kph to short third. Saha couldn't collect it properly on first attempt but it lodged in. Direct hit would have gotten him
Length on middle and leg at 95kph, nudged to the right of Rashid who tried to chase it. Jadeja was in his way, bowler was able to slow down to avoid collision
Yorker on leg at 96kph, flicked to deep midwicket
Length outside off, spins in and guides to point
Back-of-hand slower ball is full, drilled into the ground, back to the bowler. Mohit throws as Jadeja's momentum took him forward. Ball deflected around the thigh and went towards cover point
Makes room and slaps the length ball to deep point
Length outside off, guided to deep third
Jadeja tries to defend the slower one but pulls out after being deceived. Length ball pitches around off and angles away, batter tries to go towards cover before retracting the bat
Bouncer doesn't rise high, It's 120kph quick, angling away to fifth stump, hit off the inner-half of the horizontal bat to midwicket
Tries to whip the length ball off the back foot, gets it towards midwicket
Tight run taken to cover. Full ball at 143kph, Rayudu made room and got it to Pandya, who sent in the throw to Shami. Seemed to have been a bit of hesitation but Rayudu made it before losing his bat
Hurried on the pull, fizzles off the sticker to deep-backward square. Bouncer was over middle around shoulder-height.
Length on top of middle and off at 133kph, flicked off the inside-half of the bat to long-on
Slower one on a length. Clipped from top of off to long-on
Straight drive middled, races along the ground. Miller runs and dives to the right from long-on to stop it without going close to the ropes. Pace: 139kph

Conway's struggle ends with a catch to midwicket. Slot ball, closer to length than half-volley, but very much hittable from fourth stump. Conway tried to whip it across the line, it ballooned and parachuted into Rashid's hands.
Rayudu dances down first ball, manufactures width and spanks it off a length through extra cover

Another soft dismissal off Nalkande's bowling, no no-ball this time. No celebrations from the bowler this time. It was a length outside off that Rahane tried to steer off the back foot with an open-faced bat. Ended up spooning it to backward point
Flicked off the pads over square leg for a 69-metre six. It was on the pads, just under the knee roll and Rahane picked it up with ease
Whips it off the hips with that full flow again. Mistimed again. Rolls to deep-backward square

Outside edge off the flashing cover drive goes wide of the diving Saha. Length outside off at 137kph, Conway tried to cover drive with the helicopter-shot follow-through. Saha was a tad late to dive to his left. That meant he didn't have access, went just to the left of his gloves
Clears the front leg, goes inside out over cover. It was overpitched at the stumps, it was the slower one
Fullish ball on off is 85kph, slow by Rashid's standards. Inside edge off the full-faced bat takes it towards square leg
Drills the full ball into the pitch. Goes over the bowler to the deep

Is that a drop? Hard chance for Saha who was jumping. Conway tried to dab a length ball coming in towards fifth stump. It took a thin edge and the deflection took the ball to the left and it bounced off the keeper's closing wrist. Stopped by short third
Top edges the slog sweep but the full ball is down leg allowing the ball to go over the infield behind square
Full ball is flicked off the pads to deep midwicket
Inside edge takes the legbreak on a length, turning into middle, to short fine. Conway tried to punch it straight, off the back foot. His bottom hand came off the bat. CSK's hundred is up
Pulls it off his hips to deep midwicket
Bottom hand is off the bat for the slashy cover drive. Conway is too early on the slower ball at 111kph, goes into the grass. Then to the fielder in the ring

Slower one on an in-between length outside off. Square driven to the right of backward point. Conway slid his bat through the crease as the throw came on the bounce. No direct hit, backed up on the leg side
Length ball is punched off a length past the diving cover fielder. Rolls to the deep
Punches the length ball in the channel at 135kph to cover
Tries to paddle after going across. Tries to paddle it off a full length, goes through with it too early. Ball goes off the body towards short third
Reverse sweeps the full ball from off, at the lower speed of 85kph, to deep point
Conway charges and tries to go for his trademark whip. Gets it off the inside-edge of the bat, gets it to backward square
Length outside off at 98kph, cut to deep point

Dube's leg stump is knocked over! Noor sends across the goog on a fullish length, lands around off and spins in. Dube tries to launch it over wide long-on and misses it completely. Two wickets in successive overs.
Charges and tries to biff it across. Gets to the pitch, tries to get it from around fifth stump. Ball rolls along the ground to long-on
Googly beats the slog sweep, goes off a length to the pad. Ball deflects to the leg side
Dube ducks under the bouncer. It's around shoulder height but went to his right. He looked to the square-leg umpire, who signalled one bouncer for the over
Pulls a short ball outside off at 138kph that doesn't come on to deep midwicket. Conway tried to muscle it but was too early on it
In-between length on fourth stump, driven to deep cover

Top edge balloons, Miller settles and takes it at long-on! MIller points to the spidercam right after. Back of length around off, doesn't bounce as well. Gaikwad shaped to pull it but had to crouch and get low. Ball popped up, Miller ran in and took it in front of the breadbasket. Gaikwad ends with 60 after getting a reprieve on 2, thanks to Nalkande's no-ball
Bouncer just outside off, pulled into the ground. Bottom hand comes off, ball goes to deep-backward square. Mohit is grunting as he lets go of the ball
Length outside off, Gaikwad tries to slap it through cover. Bat face closes, ball goes to long-on
Makes room and thrashes an off-drive along the ground to the deep
Length ball is flat and angles in to fourth stump. The 96kph bounces a bit extra, Conway tried to steer it to short fine. Managed to do it, but the ball went off the glove
Strides towards the line, clears the back leg and flicks the fullish ball to deep midwicket
Whips the full ball from outside off to long-on

Conway mistimes an inside-out shot, luckily it goes over backward point. It was flighted invitingly, overpitched and outside off. Conway almost swung himself off shape as he smacked it. Hardik is disappointed, Saha applauds the bowler's courage
Wide yorker, jammed with the open-faced bat to deep point
Length outside off, guided to deep third
French cut, actual cut attempted by Gaikwad. Goes to the left of the keeper and is very fine.
Leading edge off the flick goes to deep third. Conway's feet got a bit stuck as he tried to drag it from fourth stump off the back foot, hovered in the gap.
Slightly closer on a similar length, punched to the off side.

Gaikwad brings up fifty with a flash behind point. Gets a rousing round of applause from the fans. Shortish ball outside off, Gaikwad rolls the wrist on the back-foot square drive. Races through the gap
Length ball is wide, steered to deep third off the back foot. Conway's run tally this season is up to 602 now
Down the track, gets close to the pitch and tries the Conway flick with the full wind-up and follow-through. Gets it to long-on
Full on middle, flicked to long-on
Wide around a length, Conway tries to drag it across with a slog sweep. Bat turns inwards, rolls along to midwicket
Fullish length around sixth, goes back and guides to short third
Overpitched on fourth, given some air too. Pace still 92kph. Driven through cover to the deep
Overpitched down leg, Gaikwad clears the back leg and flicks it along the ground to the left of deep square leg
Backs away and whips the length ball on leg to deep midwicket
Wide and full, tries to reach out and slap through point. Underedges it onto the ground, ball rolls to the off side
Dabbed away past third. Legbreak on a length outside, Gaikwad missed the shot first ball last over. But he was able to lunge, open the face late and guide it past slip
Length on middle and off at 96kph, blocked back to the bowler

Tucks the length ball off the back foot to the left of deep midwicket. Long-on charges too, the former hurls in a quick throw. Direct hit at the non-striker's end. Miller, the fielder, is excited but Conway was well in
Wide and full, thrashed. AIm was to drive over cover, went off the edge to deep point. Fifty stand is up as is the score
Overpitched outside off, Conway's front foot is planted across and he tries to power a cover drive. Goes too hard and the timing is compromised. Ball rolls to cover
Wide on a length at 91kph, underedge off the slashing horizontal blade takes the ball into the grass, off to point

Edge off the cut flies past Shanka. It was short, floated and wide. Conway slashed hard, the fielder leapt to the right and the ball was out of his reach. Rashid leapt in anticipation in the field before landing with hands on head
Length around off, defended to cover
Length ball comes in and beats the inside edge as Gaikwad tries to block with a straight bat. Spun in and hit under the knee roll. Going down leg, so the appeal was stifled early
Short and Gaikwad pulls it through square leg. He rocked back, the half-tracker ball sat up and was going onto off. Whacked with power
Length on middle and off at 91kph, nudged to deep midwicket
Too full and Gaikwad thumps it inside out. He made a bit of room, cleared his back foot out the way and drove it over cover.
Length ball with a bit of low bounce is clipped from just under the knee-roll through midwicket
Dances down. Gaikwad slows down a bit as he punches the length ball outside off to cover
Dabs the length ball at 91kph past slip, short third runs to the outfield and the batters take an easy two
Cut beaten. Flat on a length outside off, Gaikwad's upper body was bending and he tried to cut it late. Ball was too quick and went to the keeper
Steered along the ground. That's a top-of-off length ball, Conway stays leg side and opens the face of the bat last second. Middles it through the gap at point

Conway premeditates the paddle and the ball almost goes back onto the stumps. Conway went across early, he missed the length ball and it deflected from the body and slowed down as it rolled towards the stumps. Conway was falling over but was able to pull the ball from the base of his bat from just in front of the stumps
Shortish ball over middle, chips a back-foot flick wide of midwicket. Wide to the right of the fielder. Rolls to the deep
Defends a length ball in front

Charges and Nalkande tucks him up with a shortish ball. Misfield by Noor at mid-off allows three. Fans cheer. Conway went down early and Conway jammed a flick with bat close to his thigh. It fizzled along the ground. Noor was charging and slid across, the ball went past him. He shows the bowler a palm, gesticulating an apology
Hard length on fourth stump at 133kph, punched to cover
Length on fourth, blocked to cover
Underedges onto the pitch, back towards the keeper. Length outside off, Gaikwad tried to dab it towards third there.
Not overpitched but Gaikwad strides across and drives through cover on the up, with a full follow-through. In-between length around fifth stump, the batter just eased it along the ground
Back of length outside off, guided off the back foot to point

Conway tries to hit Shami out of his length by charging. It's on a length angling into fourth stump. Conway drives through cover and the bat face opens and turns inwards. Not perfectly timed but good intent shown.
Pushes towards cover, looks for a single. Conway is sent back early. Length in the channel, he defended it and moved instinctively but the fielder was close and charging
Length outside off at 134kph, punched to forward point
Shortish ball outside off, guided to deep third off the back foot
Gaikwad's feet are moving well now. Leans into the length ball in the channel, pushes it past the diving fielder at cover. Outfield is quick
Free hit is pulled off a length from outside off, middled over wide mid-on and the CSK players look to catch the ball in the dressing room

Softest of dismissals as Gaikwad spoons it to midwicket! Nalkande has his first. No, he hasn't! Nalkande has overstepped and the crowd go berserk. It was a length ball angling around off, Gaikwad tried to clip it slightly away from the body. Bat face closed too soon. It ballooned to Gill. Nalkande pumped his fist before he found out he had overstepped. Hardik has his hands on Nalkande's shoulders and has a chat.

Beaten on the back-foot square punch. Back of length outside off at 136kph, kicks off the surface and goes over fifth stump. Gaikwad was on the back foot and tried to steer it square. It went over the bat.
Length outside off, the wobble ball is steered late. Goes to deep third
Length on top of off, closer to the back-of-length area. Dabbed to deep third off a thick outside edge. Played with very soft hands by Conway.
Banged on a hard length but that came in straight. Angles into the thigh pad after beating the flick, deflected to the leg side
Gaikwad pokes and is beaten! Length outside off, landed around fourth stump and curved away, Gaikwad initially looked to defend it but withdrew his bat midway. Almost takes the edge on the way.
Similar ball at 141kph, Gaikwad opens the bat face to get it to the right of deep third. Little there, runs across a few metres, they take two.
Length in the channel, blocked to cover
Big away swing first ball. Lands around off on a back of length curves away to go past around sixth stump. Left alone. Saha leaps to the right and stops it on the bounce as it dies down. Pace: 136kph

A tenth IPL final for CSK in 14 seasons of their history. And what a way to seal it, with a catch running square from mid off. Short ball around off, slapped high up in the air, and mid-off was committed for the catch even though the win was decided. One-handed from Chahar and then pulls up, maybe a strain
or maybe not. Because Pathirana continues bowling wides. Low full toss outside leg
good length ball on middle. Pulled to deep midwicket.
full ball outside off. Swings across the line, thick edge takes it over short third
short of length outside off. Clubbed down the ground where Moeen at long on cleans up
low full toss on off. Swiped to deep midwicket for a single
full toss outside leg and Dhoni does well to get his body behind the ball's line. They scurry across for an extra run with Dhoni missing an attempted run out
good length ball around off. Flat-batted to long on for a single
overpitched outside off. Shami can't connect, through to Dhoni on the bounce. Deshpande finishes with 1-43

full ball around off and middle. Shami clears the front leg and clubs a shot over the leg side. One-bounce four. Dhoni is not happy that Deshpande bowled closer to the stumps on this occasion. Bad ball with the field set.
full ball outside off. Shami tries to cream a shot over cover. But no connection

MS magic again? Dhoni strengthens the off side before this ball, moving Conway towards deep point, and the ball has gone straight to him. Another low full toss outside off and Rashid sliced the shot straight to him. Nehra gives Rashid a pat on the back as he walks back for a 16-ball 30
Rashid moves to the off side and Deshpande bowls wide outside the tram-lines. Rashid misses and the umpire says that is NOT a wide. Probably because of Rashid's movement before the ball was released
just the start Titans needed. Low full toss outside off and Rashid successfully slices a shot over cover
slower ball, full around leg. Noor flicks it high up in the air but well short of deep square leg. Single turned down! What a terrific over

lbw appeal, umpire Chaudhary says no. And the Titans support staff all crowd around the TV in the dugout to see. CSK review. This was a full ball landing around leg and tailing down. Hits the back leg. Ball-tracking confirms this is hitting outside leg stump. Not out.
full ball outside leg. Goes down the leg side. But that run-out got Rashid back on strike

run-out for a golden duck! Full ball around off. Drilled to mid off too hard and still he tries the single. Sub fielder Senapati with a clean pick up and throw from mid-off, and Nalkande is a few metres out of the crease.

Gaik-waddafielder! Full ball around leg stump. Shankar flicked it high in the air off his toes. Gaikwad runs in quickly from deep midwicket and then puts his body on the line with a dive forward. Clean catch, Shankar is outta here!
low full toss around off. Drilled to mid off and they take the single after a misfield
full ball just outside off and mistimed to cover's right for a quick single

full toss outside off. Rashid tried to scoop it over fine leg but couldn't get bat on ball. Poor choice of shot for that line. Might've been pre-meditated. Nonetheless, an over that Titans desperately needed

chance of a catch? No, it is four instead! Deshpande with a knee-high full toss. Rashid goes for a wild swing. Big outside edge, lands awkwardly in front of Theekshana at short third, and then bursts past him for four
swatted away. Length ball, just sat up from outside off. Rashid used his powerful arms to flat-bat a shot over long on. Pace off
swing and miss. Fuller ball, outside off again. Rashid lose his shape while swinging across the line.
length ball, but outside the tram-lines again. The plan is clear, execution needs to improve slightly. But then again he can't be too predictable either
length ball outside off and Shankar hammers a flat-bated shot to long off
homeboy gets it over long off. He moved a few inches to the off side as soon as the ball was released. Got closer to the delivery and then got under it to send it for half a dozen
full ball, outside the tram-lines. Expected line with protection at deep point. Wide this time though
paddled away past MSD. Full ball around leg and Rashid very cutely gets some bat to send it for four to fine leg. Thirteen off the over as we take another break.
length ball, but away from Rashid's arc, and yet inside the tram-lines. He swings and misses.
hammered in front of square by Rashid. Short ball, fifth-stump line, and Rashid swats it over wide long off
yorker just outside leg but that is perfect because Rashid had moved leg side too. Batter cramps himself
full ball on off and Rashid helicopters a shot towards deep midwicket. Two more.
low full toss around off stump and driven to mid off for a single
full ball just outside off stump. Guided to point for a single
full toss around off and driven to long off for a single.
full ball outside off. Turning away and driven with the spin to wide long off. They reach 100 with that double

let's start the whistle-podu! Theekshana with a second and brings out his trademark celebration. Good length ball around middle and off. Tewatia tries to guide it to the leg side but this 103kph delivery goes past his edge.

full ball around middle and off. Tewatia changes his stance and goes for a reverse sweep. Mistimed, gone high up, but in the gap at conventional deep third. Rahana runs around from deep backward point to cut this boundary off
Theekshana for his final over. Full ball around off and driven along the carpet to mid on
short ball, pace off, angling away from Tewatia. Tries to slap it away but misses. On the bounce to MS
length ball just outside off. Cut towards deep backward point for a single
good length ball around off and he pulls in front of square along the ground. The two is a dangerous call but they complete it comfortably in the end
good length ball sliding down the leg side again. Originating on a middle-stump line but the angle just taking it down
good length ball around middle and leg. Sliding down the leg side. Slower ball
short-ish ball around off but it doesn't bounce as much. Iceman Tewatia pulls to deep midwicket
slower ball, rolling his fingers over that delivery. Fullish ball outside off and angling further away
good length ball around off and pushed straight back

Chahar has got his man! This was a short ball at only 111kph. Gill got set for the pull but he's a bit too early into the shot. Ball in the air and Conway at deep square leg runs around to grab that catch. The crowd erupts, Chahar looks up to the skies.
full ball around off and carefully fended away by Shankar. Jadeja finishes a terrific spell

Jaddu-gar He is a magician. Earns his reward for bowling stump-to-stump. Ball skids straight through with Miller kinda late on the punch with minimal footwork. Ball squirts through the bat-body gap after taking an edge, and then turns around to see his stumps rattled.
full ball outside off. Gill charges down the track and slaps a shot to Conway at deep cover
full ball around off. Checks the cut late but gets the shot to go towards vacant cover point
full ball on middle. Turning to off. Gill taps it towards the off side for a single
Jadeja over the stumps. Good length around off, and nurdled to the off side for a single
full ball just outside off. A beautiful-looking drive that goes straight to mid off.
full ball landing around leg and going further down the leg side. That's the fourth wide

good length ball, fourth-stump line.  Slapped in front of square, and Deshpande is a bit slow to attack the ball in the deep. Allows them to take the double. Gill is sweating and he is also grabbing his hamstring
short ball, rather wide, and the straight-on umpire agrees with that assessment too. No shot offered by Gill
aiming for the yorker, very nearly delivered perfectly. Lands around Gill's heel, and he manages to clip it away to deep fine leg. 147kph
short ball, fifth-stump line, enough width for Gill to capitalise on on most days. This time he cuts straight to point
full on mdidle and Miller wants to drive straighter than where the ball eventually went. This flew to mid off's right
misses his line again. Fullish ball pitching outside leg. Miller did swing the bat but got no connection
full ball just outside off. Gill drives to mid off for a quick single
starts off with a wayward delivery. The slinger lands outside the tram-lines
full ball on off and drilled back. Jadeja puts his body behind the ball's line and intercepts. Jadeja with an impressive over
full ball around off. Driven through the big gap at cover to the man in the deep
good length ball on off and he punches it to wide mid-on for a single

reverse sweep doesn't work! Two dots and then the wicket. Shanaka tries to lift the reverse sweep from middle stump, but he doesn't time it well. He got tangled slightly too, and Theekshana runs to his right from conventional short-third to take an easy catch. In the end, the Shanaka experiment doesn't really work out
another length ball around off that goes straight through. Shanaka attempts the cut but he can't get bat on ball
good length ball around fourth-stump line. Cuts, fine, but can't beat short third
length ball cut in front of square and Gill says 'two, two, two, two...' as soon as he connected it. Fielder in the deep has to run around a lot
fullish ball outside off and drilled to long off for a single
fullish ball around off. Shanaka tries to work it leg side but it takes a leading edge to the off side
is this why Shanaka was promoted? He's winning the battle of the Sri Lankans. Theekshana goes fullish on off. Shanaka keeps his eyes on the ball and goes inside out to hammer it over long off.
lands just beyond deep midwicket's reach. Theekshana went full, Shanaka attempted the big shot, and he ended up hitting it from the bat's inside half. Very nearly out, very nearly six.
good length ball around off and middle. Ball just holds a bit after pitching. Nudged to the leg side

much needed release shot! Gill's strike-rate had dropped to just around 100 and he breaks the shackles with a four before the time out. Jadeja darts it in full around middle, and Gill is down on one knee for the sweep.
fullish ball on middle. Gill making his own room by moving leg side but he can't get in position because of Jadeja's pace. Bunted to the off side
full ball around off and he drives to long on for a single
good length ball around off. Big turn away again. This time surprising Shanaka who backs away
fullish on middle. Gill stays on the back foot and nudges it to the leg side for a single
good length ball outside off and guided to cover point for a single
good length ball around off. Pushed down to long on for a single
full ball outside off stump and he drives to Moeen who is standing at short cover
good length ball around off and middle. Stays on the back foot and works it to square leg
full ball around off stump. Driven to long on for a walking single
full ball on middle and leg. Guided to the big gap at midwicket, and they call for two very early
full ball on middle, and clipped to midwicket for one
tentatively cuts this length ball to point. In the air briefly
that turned! Jadeja lets it rip. Length ball outside off and turning away sharply. Gill pulls out of the shot after spotting that turn
good length ball, tapped back straight
closer to the stumps. Length on middle, and nudged to the leg side
good length ball, around off. Bit of turn away. Gill cuts it and gets it past point, and its too far for deep point as well
Sri Lankan to Sri Lankan. Good length ball around off and cut square

and that protection pays off! Forced Hardik to go over the infield because it was so packed. Theekshana with a length ball on a fourth-stump line. Hardik miscues the cut. Jadeja at point jumps up and holds on. Theekshana with a passionate celebration.
good length ball around off. Cut to Moeen in front of square. Theekshana staying on the stumps, forcing the batters to move around instead

good length ball around off. Gill makes room and slaps in front of square, getting it to the left of mid off. But former India U-19 vice captain Shaik Rasheed runs to his left and throws his body at it. Saves three runs
fullish ball around off. Skidding through and Gill taps it back
fullish ball around off and driven to mid on for a single

boundary off the last ball and this time Gill waited for that sort of length, inside his crease. Stands tall and swats a pull over midwicket. Timing not perfect but that's always four once it clears the infield
good length ball around middle and angling into leg. Gill comes down the track, but he is cramped. The pull is mistimed straight back to Hardik instead
good length ball, fourth-stump line. Checks his pull and sends the shot to the midwicket fielder
short-ish ball around off and pulled square. Falls just short of the outfielder at deep square leg. This was close!
attempted slower ball. Ended up rather overpitched, and outside off. But enough pace change to deceive Gill. Mistimed drive to cover
length ball around middle and leg, but this one doesn't bounce as much. Hardik swipes across his pads and sends the ball to deep square leg
fullish ball around off. Played straight back, and Gill says 'no' straight away. Two boundaries in that over
sweet as....! Full ball, rather floaty, landing on off. Gill gets forward, head on top of the ball, and then flicked past midwicket.
fullish ball just outside off. Pushed to mid off for a quick single
pierces the gap on the off side. Deshpande went fullish outside off but Pandya was very balanced while playing that drive on the up.
takes pace off. Good length ball around off and Gill mistimes a punchy shot down to mid-on for a single
in the slot, just outside off. Gill with an exquisite cover drive, but the fielder dives to his right to stop that.

Chahar-Pathirana combine! And the crowd loves this. Chahar goes good-length on a stump-to-stump line. Saha swivels for a pull but this time he rolls his wrists over the shot at the last moment. That means the ball is flying behind square instead of going in front. And Pathirana at deep square leg does not have to move an inch.
good length ball around off. Saha pirouettes around his toes and thumps a pull in front of square, getting it past midwicket
fullish ball, fourth-ball stump. Rather close to Gill's body for the cut but he goes for it anyway. Chopped in front of square where there are two CSK fielders
keeper goes back.  Chahar with a good-length ball on a fourth-stump line. Tapped after riding the bounce to point
back of length around leg. Gill swivels to pull, but it hits his body and rolls away to short fine. Maybe it was bat and body, but the umpire signals leg bye
poor line from Chahar. Full around leg and Gill quickly spots that. Flicks, breaks his wrists right at the end, and sends the ball for six over fine leg.
this time it is over Chahar! The first boundary of the innings and this is Saha lifting a slot ball with ease, and sending it to long-on for four.

full ball just outside off. Gill brings out the checked on-drive that flies to mid-off's right. Quite flat, though, making it tough for Chahar moving to his right. He gets a fingertip to it, but the difficult chance goes down as dropped
full ball just outside off. Gill stands tall and punches a shot down to mid off. Sweet timing, but straight to the fielder

shouts of 'catch' but it falls between cover and mid off. Good-length ball popped up off the surface with Saha trying to punch it over cover. Mistimed, in the air, but lands short of Rayudu running to his left from mid-off
full ball angling into his pads. Guided to midwicket but Saha is quick to say 'no' for the single
full ball outside off stump. Tempts Saha forward and he looks to meet the ball. But there's some late swing away, and it very nearly took Saha's edge
yes he can. Length ball outside off with a bit of swing away. Guided to third man, where Deshpande cleans up
length ball originating outside off. But angling into the stumps. Saha fends it after standing tall
full ball outside off and Saha leans into it with soft hands, pushing it to point
good length again. Around off. Flicked off his waist towards midwicket for an easy single
on a good length around off. Bit of swing away. Gill tentatively fends and wants one, but Saha turns him down
full ball on his pads and rather comfortably clipped to deep square leg
